analysis.narrative:

· 현재가(1,113,000원) vs SMA5(1,131,600원) 하회, SMA20(1,273,100원) 하회, SMA50(1,490,980원) 하회: 단기·중기 추세 약세 진단
· SMA100(1,655,628원) 하회, SMA200(1,528,524원) 하회: 중장기 추세 약세 강도
· 52주 위치(24.6%) + 현 가격대 52주 저가 대비 121.7% 수준
[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 40.1 → 37.9 (과매도 탈출): 과매도 구간 진입, 하락세 둔화
· MACD 히스토그램 314.0351 → -1743.5036 (악화): 약세 지속 신호
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 하단(1,006,167원) 근처: 밴드폭 41.93%로 넓은 편
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 (1,089,000원): 피벗 S1(939,000원) 상회, 20일 저가 기반
· 스윙 저항선 (1,317,000원): 돌파 시 추세 전환 기대
· 5일 고가(1,222,000원) / 저가(1,092,000원), 20일 고가(1,587,000원) / 저가(1,089,000원): Higher Low 형성 시도
[거래량·결론]

· 현 구간 진단 (하락추세): 1,089,000원 지지 확인 시 매수 진입 고려
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (1,113,000 KRW) below SMA5 (1,131,600 KRW), SMA20 (1,273,100 KRW), SMA50 (1,490,980 KRW): diagnosing short-to-medium term trend as bearish.
· Below SMA100 (1,655,628 KRW), SMA200 (1,528,524 KRW): indicating strong mid-to-long term bearish trend.
· 52-week position (24.6%) + current price level is 121.7% above the 52-week low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 40.1 → 37.9 (exiting oversold): entering oversold territory, decelerating decline.
· MACD histogram 314.0351 → -1743.5036 (worsening): signal of continued bearishness.
· Bollinger Band current price near the lower band (1,006,167 KRW): band width at 41.93% is relatively wide.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support at 1,089,000 KRW: above Pivot S1 (939,000 KRW), based on 20-day low.
· Swing resistance at 1,317,000 KRW: potential for trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day high (1,222,000 KRW) / low (1,092,000 KRW), 20-day high (1,587,000 KRW) / low (1,089,000 KRW): attempting to form a Higher Low.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio 1.04 (normal): moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend): consider buy entry upon confirmation of support at 1,089,000 KRW.
